notes: Updating is one tap: however many updates you missed, you jump straight to the newest Nexa — with a new 'Unlocking your new Nexa' screen
Nexa never asks you to delete or re-add the app again
After an update, Nexa walks you through each new thing, one at a time
Lock Nexa with a PIN or with Face ID / fingerprint
Calls ring with sound even when Nexa is closed (turn on notifications), stop ringing on your other devices when you answer, and show 'Missed call' if nobody answers
